events.title: The Annunciation
events.blurb: Gabriel comes to a virgin in Nazareth: 'thou shalt call his name JESUS.' Mary answers, 'be it unto me according to thy word,' and Elisabeth's babe leaps at her greeting.

events.title: The Nativity
events.blurb: No room in the inn — the Son of God is laid in a manger while angels fill the night sky over shepherds' fields near Bethlehem.

events.title: The Boy in the Temple
events.blurb: Twelve years old, missing for three days, found among the doctors — 'wist ye not that I must be about my Father's business?'

events.title: The Baptism of Jesus
events.blurb: John baptizes the Messiah in the Jordan 'to fulfil all righteousness' — the Spirit descends like a dove, and the Father's voice owns His Beloved Son.

events.title: Forty Days in the Wilderness
events.blurb: After fasting forty days, Jesus meets the tempter three times — and answers every temptation with scripture: 'Get thee hence, Satan.'

events.title: The Sermon on the Mount
events.blurb: The Beatitudes, salt and light, the higher law, the Lord's Prayer — the constitution of the kingdom, taught on a Galilean hillside.

events.title: The Twelve Apostles Called
events.blurb: After a night of prayer on a mountain, Jesus chooses twelve from among His disciples and names them apostles.

events.title: Feeding the Five Thousand
events.blurb: Five barley loaves and two small fishes from a boy's lunch feed a multitude — then Jesus declares Himself the Bread of Life, and many walk away.

events.title: Peter's Confession at Caesarea Philippi
events.blurb: 'Whom say ye that I am?' — 'Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God.' Flesh and blood hath not revealed it; the keys of the kingdom are promised.

events.title: The Transfiguration
events.blurb: On a high mountain His face shines as the sun; Moses and Elijah appear, and the Father's voice from the cloud commands: 'hear ye him.'

events.title: Lazarus Raised from the Dead
events.blurb: Four days in the tomb. Jesus weeps with the sisters, then cries 'Lazarus, come forth' — and the dead man comes, bound in graveclothes.

events.title: The Triumphal Entry
events.blurb: Riding a colt over spread garments and palm branches, Jesus enters Jerusalem to cries of 'Hosanna to the Son of David' — and cleanses the temple.

events.title: The Last Supper
events.blurb: The Lord girds Himself with a towel and washes His disciples' feet, names His betrayer, and gives the new commandment: love one another, as I have loved you.

events.title: Gethsemane
events.blurb: 'Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup... nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.' His sweat as great drops of blood; an angel strengthens Him; a kiss betrays Him.

events.title: The Crucifixion
events.blurb: Pilate yields; at Golgotha the Lamb of God is lifted up between two thieves. He gives His mother to John, then bows His head: 'It is finished.'

events.title: The Resurrection
events.blurb: The stone rolled away, the linen clothes lying empty — and Mary Magdalene, weeping in the garden, hears one word: 'Mary.'

events.title: The Ascension
events.blurb: After forty days of infallible proofs, He is taken up from the Mount of Olives — 'this same Jesus... shall so come in like manner as ye have seen him go.'

events.title: The Day of Pentecost
events.blurb: A rushing mighty wind, cloven tongues of fire, and Peter's first great sermon — three thousand souls are baptized in a day.

events.title: Stephen the First Martyr
events.blurb: His face like an angel's, Stephen sees the heavens opened and the Son of Man on the right hand of God — and dies praying for the men who stone him.

events.title: Saul on the Damascus Road
events.blurb: A light above the noonday sun fells the church's fiercest persecutor: 'Saul, Saul, why persecutest thou me?' Three days blind, he rises a chosen vessel.

events.title: The Gospel Goes to the Gentiles
events.blurb: Cornelius's prayers and Peter's vision of the sheet meet in Caesarea — 'God is no respecter of persons,' and the Holy Ghost falls on the Gentiles.

events.title: Paul's Missionary Journeys
events.blurb: Set apart by the Spirit at Antioch, Paul and his companions carry the gospel across Cyprus, Asia Minor, and Greece — planting churches and writing epistles.

events.title: Paul's Voyage to Rome
events.blurb: Having appealed unto Caesar, Paul sails as a prisoner into a fourteen-day tempest — an angel promises no life lost, and the ship breaks apart at Malta.

events.title: Revelation on Patmos
events.blurb: Exiled 'for the word of God,' John hears a great voice as of a trumpet on the Lord's day — and the glorified Christ unveils the things which must shortly come to pass.
